title: Fantastic Pinball Thrills
description:
Are you ready for the ultimate Pinball challenge? The authentically detailed Pinball tables are inviting you to a round of thrilling arcade action. The modern technology ensures a top-notch, state-of-the-art physics simulation. Marvel at the superb realism, right down to the reflections, on 6 uniquely themed tables with a variety of camera perspectives that deliver the perfect Pinball feeling.Features• 6 unique pinball tables: “Fly Away”, “Racing”, “In Space”, “Castle”, “Break the Speed”, “Oktoberfest”

• Top-notch simulations of ramps, bumpers and switches

• Fantastic pinball physics

• Multiple camera angles ensure a totally immersive pinball feeling

• Authentic atmosphere right down to realistic reflections and sound effects

• Gamepad Support
